notes: Analemma: hold the clock and touch the Sun to draw the year's figure-8 at this clock time; drag along it to scrub the date with snaps at solstices, equinoxes and equation-of-time extremes; the crossing shows both dates; readout 'Sun N m fast · solar noon'; clock mode standard or local mean (Settings). Picking: taps on the wheel pick the likeliest body, or fan close glyphs to choose. Cosmodex cards for the ten luminaries (tap a focused body): Ptolemy quote with source, NASA facts, live position, its cry; flip for sources; works on the cover screen.
